p5_b1.ocr: There are several mechanisms that could underlie potential CV benefits for linagliptin. First, linagliptin may confer the beneficial effects of improved glycaemic control, including the lowering of postprandial glucose, without the potentially harmful effects of weight gain or increased hypoglycaemia [12,26]. Second, linagliptin increases GLP-1 and GIP levels which may provide ben- eficial cardioprotection; experimental and clinical data suggest that GLP-1 elevation can positively modulate lipid metabolism [26], reduce infarct size and improve cardiac function [26,27].
